_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in the two LINE secrets. config.json is gitignored.
_channelSecret: LINE Developers Console -> your channel -> Basic settings
_channelAccessToken: LINE Developers Console -> Messaging API -> issue a long-lived token
_ownerUserId: Your own LINE userId. Printed to the log the first time you message the bot.
_allowedUserIds: Family members' LINE userIds. Everyone else gets a refusal and cannot reach the hospital through this bot.
_dryRunLine: true prints outbound LINE calls instead of sending them - use while testing
